title: Conformational Change of Transcription Factors from Search to Specific Binding: A lac Repressor Case Study.
authors: Luking, Malin; Elf, Johan; Levy, Yaakov
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化分子动力学模拟研究lac阻遏蛋白在搜索与特异性结合DNA过程中的构象变化，揭示一维扩散与靶位识别机制，高度契合TF-DNA动态互作建模课题。
abstract: In a process known as facilitated diffusion, DNA-binding proteins find their target sites by combining three-dimensional diffusion and one-dimensional scanning of the DNA. Following the trade-off between speed and stability, agile exploration of DNA requires loose binding, whereas, at the DNA target site, the searching protein needs to establish tight interactions with the DNA. To enable both efficient search and stable binding, DNA-binding proteins and DNA often switch conformations upon recognition. Here, we study the one-dimensional diffusion and DNA binding of the dimeric lac repressor (LacI), which was reported to adopt two different conformations when binding different conformations of DNA. Using coarse-grained molecular dynamic simulations, we studied the diffusion and the sequence-specific binding of these conformations of LacI, as well as their truncated or monomeric variants, with two DNA conformations: straight and bent. The simulations were compared to experimental observables. This study supports that linear diffusion along DNA combines tight rotation-coupled groove tracking and rotation-decoupled hopping, where the protein briefly dissociates and reassociates just a few base pairs away. Tight groove tracking is crucial for target-site recognition, while hopping speeds up the overall search process. We investigated the diffusion of different LacI conformations on DNA and show how the flexibility of LacI's hinge regions ensures agility on DNA as well as faithful groove tracking. If the hinge regions instead form alpha-helices at the protein-DNA interface, tight groove tracking is not possible. On the contrary, the helical hinge region is essential for tight binding to bent, specific DNA, for the formation of the specific complex. Based on our study of different encounter complexes, we argue that the conformational change in LacI and DNA bending are somewhat coupled. Our findings underline the importance of two distinct protein conformations for facilitated diffusion and specific binding, respectively.
abstract_zh: 在称为协助扩散（facilitated diffusion）的过程中，DNA结合蛋白通过结合三维扩散和沿DNA的一维扫描来寻找其靶位点。在速度与稳定性之间的权衡下，敏捷的DNA探索需要松散结合，而在DNA靶位点处，搜索蛋白则需要与DNA建立紧密相互作用。为了实现高效搜索和稳定结合，DNA结合蛋白和DNA在识别时常会切换构象。在此，我们研究二聚体lac阻遏物（LacI）的一维扩散和DNA结合，据报道该蛋白在结合不同构象的DNA时采用两种不同构象。利用粗粒化分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，我们研究了这些LacI构象及其截短或单体变体在两种DNA构象（直链和弯曲）上的扩散和序列特异性结合。模拟结果与实验观测值进行了比较。本研究支持沿DNA的线性扩散结合了紧密的旋转耦合沟槽追踪和旋转解耦跳跃，其中蛋白短暂解离并在仅几个碱基对之外重新结合。紧密的沟槽追踪对靶位点识别至关重要，而跳跃则加速了整体搜索过程。我们研究了不同LacI构象在DNA上的扩散，并展示了LacI铰链区的灵活性如何确保在DNA上的敏捷性以及忠实的沟槽追踪。如果铰链区在蛋白-DNA界面形成α-螺旋，则无法实现紧密的沟槽追踪。相反，螺旋铰链区对于紧密结合弯曲的特异性DNA以及形成特异性复合物至关重要。基于对不同遭遇复合物的研究，我们认为LacI的构象变化与DNA弯曲在一定程度上是耦合的。我们的发现强调了两种不同蛋白构象分别对协助扩散和特异性结合的重要性。
